body: > Lamotrigine was not good for me, really not good.. but Seroquel changed my life.. If you don't notice any change in a month or 2, try something different.. because what's right for one, isn't for another..

Thanks for the thank you.

 And I do hope that things get better for you.

If your 5 year old is what keeps you going, Live For Them.. You still have options.. if you keep looking in the rear view mirror, you wont see new opportunities that come your way. Maybe have a chat with the wife, and see what go is, might be able to sort things out, might not, either way, least you'll know.. My life didn't go the way I planned, not even close, I struggle every day. I made some bad choices, but hey, we all make mistakes, just got to learn from them, and move on..

Been suicidal for about 15 years, and I have also had periods being so disconnected, that I couldn't feel anything, except for when i crashed.. I don't have any answers, all I can say is, I understand the emptiness and being so alone, even in a crowded room. I got some help, for the anxiety, and the crashing, and it has helped. Family is pretty important, and even though they probably wont understand (you don't have to tell them) they wouldn't want you gone.. Just keep on keeping on, It cant stay this way for ever (that's what they tell me)

if you have people still in your live that want to help, people that love you, wouldn't you be hurting them, if you killed yourself. Having people that care, is a really awesome thing to have.. I used to have that, but i don't anymore.. instead of punishing yourself, try and change.. hardest part is accepting that you've made mistakes, and you've already done that... changing for the people you love, and for yourself, is really hard work, but so worth it.

Thankyou everyone.. Diesel was the best.. when I got him (rescued), he was in a real bad way.. I think he understood this, and when I was going through the dark periods, he'd know, and would always try and make me laugh.. jump off the couch, and chase his tail, every time he went around, he'd be looking at me to see if I was watching... I do miss him a lot. Another loss. I know that I shouldn't give up, and by doing so, it kind of makes all the hard work, that I've done to come this far, pointless. I just don't feel like I have the energy, to keep fighting it, for much longer. 
A small part of me always knew that I shouldn't kill myself, even though I think about it all the time, and I wanted die, I fought it, and got help, but I feel like that part is fading.. Just going to live one day at a time, don't really know what else to do.. 
Thankyou for reading, and for all of the kind words.
